name: lumoscore-near
description: LumosCore on NEAR Protocol. Separate project on purpose, like C:/LumosCore-XRPL: it READS C:/LumosCore (the Stellar base, and the shared Functions in shared-functions.json) and never writes it.

scripts.build: node C:/LumosCore/_tools/shared_functions.js . && node _tools/bake_curated.js && node _tools/extract_site.js near && node _tools/sync_assets.js
